featured_title: Moving to Southwest Florida in 2027? Why Amendment 3 Makes December 31, 2026 a Date to Know
featured_excerpt: Under Amendment 3, people who are permanent Florida residents by December 31, 2026 qualify for the larger homestead exemption, while newcomers start at $50,000 for four years. Here is what relocating buyers should know.
others_caption: Also this week: planning a move to Estero around hurricane season, Marsh Landing's two-board purchase approval, whether your buyer can actually insure your home, what Amendment 3 means for Southwest Florida homeowners, Cascades at Estero after its builder's bankruptcy, Grandezza vs Wildcat Run on which club sets your dues, and Tidewater by Del Webb's occupancy rules.
